routes.name: Exhaustive assessment of the existing Family 065 proof cluster

C_REVIEW.statement: The index and six unit assessments exhaust the listed old artifacts, claim versions and graph nodes, checking their strongest existing assertions, primary-source scope and formal/computational evidence without promoting them to new findings or certifying the surrounding manuscripts.

REVIEW_LOCALIZATION.statement: The existing common-R localization, scope comparison, gluing, vertex and Wick arguments, including the report-only uniqueness assertion, have a source-specific assessment distinguishing supported scope from concrete unresolved obligations.

REVIEW_COMPLETION.statement: The existing integral-label and arbitrary-E ample-completion assertions have been assessed separately from twisting the bundle or assuming the common-R conclusion.

REVIEW_EULER.statement: The existing all-multiplicity moving Euler formula, gerbe factor and endpoint-release convention have been assessed with their hypotheses and the limits of the degree-one computation.

REVIEW_MOMENTS.statement: The existing finite-moment formalization and bounded computations have been assessed by exact theorem, version, statement fidelity, historical compiler outcome and fresh replay outcome, without extending them to geometry.

REVIEW_TRANSFER.statement: Every old downstream projectivization Virasoro-transfer claim has an explicit source-specific evidentiary disposition without a new investigation of the manuscript.

REVIEW_SEWING.statement: Complete-intersection sewing has an explicit disposition identifying its actual statement, manuscript dependencies and exclusion from the old localization certificate, without claiming it was proved or refuted there.
